name: Personal JARVIS
postCreateCommand: set -e; command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || (sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq unzip); zip=$(ls -t personal-jarvis-foundation*.zip | head -1); unzip -o "$zip"; cd jarvis && npm install
postAttachCommand: cd jarvis; if ! curl -sf http://localhost:8787/health >/dev/null; then nohup npm run start:api >/tmp/jarvis-api.log 2>&1 & fi; sleep 2; if ! curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null; then npm run dev --workspace @jarvis/web; fi
